description: Spec defines per-chat user preferences missing from kith: muted (Boolean), muteUntil (UTCDate, optional), pinnedMessageIds (String[]), receiveTypingIndicators (Boolean), receiptSharing (Boolean, optional), messageExpirySeconds (UnsignedInt, optional). These are owner-only settings. Needs: store columns on chats table, Chat/set update support, pin enforcement in Message/set. Spec reference: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md lines 470-487.
title: Implement Chat preferences (muted, muteUntil, pinnedMessageIds, receiveTypingIndicators, receiptSharing, messageExpirySeconds)
